title: ArcMap Identify panel with related New Zealand parcel records
sourceName: Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand
credit: Source: Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand, licensed for re-use under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). Web display copy resized and converted to WebP.
altText: ArcMap desktop geographic information system showing an identified parcel and linked property tables.
caption: LINZ's ArcMap example showing property records linked through an Esri file geodatabase, including parcels, survey plans, title estates and statutory actions.
dateDisplay: Published by LINZ by 2022; example files dated 2016
context: A genuine New Zealand desktop GIS screenshot preserved in a LINZ guide explaining file-geodatabase table relationships. The capture date is not independently confirmed, and it does not purport to show the first desktop GIS rollout.
derivativesNote: Local original stored unchanged; WebP display width up to 1600 pixels and thumbnail width up to 720 pixels, resized without cropping.
